events.title: DIPLOMATIC CHANNEL COMPROMISED
events.description: Encrypted communications between our North Atlantic allies have been intercepted. The source appears to be an inside operative. Trust is eroding at the highest levels.
events.flavor_intro: The scrambled transmission lasted 4.7 seconds. That was enough.

hidden_consequence.message: The mole surfaces. Two assets extracted. Intel networks partially burned.

choices.label: INTERNAL SECURITY SWEEP
choices.description: Lock down all communication channels and identify the leak.
choices.narrative_result: Sweep complete. One compromised asset identified and extracted. Channel integrity restored.

choices.label: FEED DISINFORMATION
choices.description: Let the leak continue but flood the channel with false intel.
choices.narrative_result: Disinformation seeded. The opposition is now chasing ghosts. A calculated risk.

choices.label: PUBLIC DISCLOSURE
choices.description: Reveal the compromise to shore up public credibility.
choices.narrative_result: Transparency noted. Public trust increased, but adversaries now know what we know.

events.title: EASTERN BLOC MILITARY EXERCISES
events.description: Unprecedented military exercises along the eastern corridor. Troop movements suggest a posturing campaign—or preparation for something larger. Satellite imagery is inconclusive.
events.flavor_intro: Forty thousand soldiers don't just take a walk.

hidden_consequence.message: Exercise becomes permanent forward deployment. Threat levels surge.

choices.label: DEPLOY SURVEILLANCE ASSETS
choices.description: Maximize real-time intelligence on troop movements.
choices.narrative_result: Full satellite and HUMINT coverage achieved. We know their every move.

choices.label: BACK-CHANNEL DIPLOMACY
choices.description: Open quiet lines of communication to de-escalate.
choices.narrative_result: Back-channel talks initiated. Exercises reduced in scale. Tension lowered—for now.

choices.label: COUNTER-DEPLOYMENT
choices.description: Match their posture with allied forces to signal resolve.
choices.narrative_result: Both sides now staring across the line. Deterrence holds—but so does the tension.

events.title: MIDDLE CORRIDOR HUMANITARIAN CRISIS
events.description: Over 800,000 civilians displaced by converging proxy conflicts. International aid organizations overwhelmed. Media coverage is spreading rapidly and demanding action.
events.flavor_intro: The cameras found the children first. They always do.

hidden_consequence.message: Displaced population radicalized by inaction. New militant cells forming.

choices.label: FUND HUMANITARIAN CORRIDOR
choices.description: Coordinate and fund a protected civilian evacuation route.
choices.narrative_result: Corridor established. 200,000 civilians moved to safety. International goodwill surges.

choices.label: MEDIA CONTROL OPERATION
choices.description: Shape the narrative—slow the story, buy time for diplomatic solution.
choices.narrative_result: Media cycle redirected. International pressure reduced. Displaced remain displaced.

choices.label: BROKER CEASEFIRE
choices.description: Use all diplomatic leverage to halt proxy fighting immediately.
choices.narrative_result: 72-hour ceasefire achieved. Fragile, but it holds. Civilians begin returning home.

events.title: PACIFIC RIM TECH ESPIONAGE RING
events.description: A state-sponsored hacking collective has penetrated three major defense contractors. Blueprints for next-generation drone systems may be compromised. The trail leads east.
events.flavor_intro: Data has no borders. Neither does ambition.

hidden_consequence.message: Stolen blueprints deployed. Adversary drone capability doubles. Our edge narrows.

choices.label: CYBER COUNTER-OPERATION
choices.description: Deploy offensive cyber tools to neutralize the intrusion.
choices.narrative_result: Counter-operation successful. Network sterilized. Attribution confirmed but deniable.

choices.label: PATCH AND MONITOR
choices.description: Close the vulnerabilities but leave monitoring in place.
choices.narrative_result: Vulnerabilities patched. Passive monitoring now reveals adversary's full operation.

choices.label: ECONOMIC SANCTIONS
choices.description: Apply targeted economic pressure on the responsible state actors.
choices.narrative_result: Sanctions announced. International community rallies. Adversary economy feels the pinch.

events.title: SOUTHERN FRONT ELECTION INTERFERENCE
events.description: Evidence emerges of foreign manipulation in three simultaneous national elections across the Southern Front. Voter data compromised. Legitimate candidates threatened.
events.flavor_intro: Democracy is just another system to be hacked.

hidden_consequence.message: Compromised governments take office. Our influence in the region collapses.

choices.label: ELECTION SECURITY ASSISTANCE
choices.description: Provide technical support to secure voting infrastructure.
choices.narrative_result: Election security bolstered. Interference neutralized. Legitimate results stand.

choices.label: COUNTER-INFLUENCE OPERATION
choices.description: Run our own influence operation to counteract foreign interference.
choices.narrative_result: Counter-narrative dominates. Favorable candidates gain ground. The hypocrisy is noted.

choices.label: UN OBSERVER MISSION
choices.description: Deploy international observers to legitimize the process.
choices.narrative_result: UN mission deployed. Global legitimacy restored. Election results accepted internationally.

events.title: NORTH ATLANTIC FINANCIAL CONTAGION
events.description: A cascading banking crisis has begun in three European capitals. Markets in freefall. The economic architecture built over seventy years is showing catastrophic stress fractures.
events.flavor_intro: The first domino fell quietly. The rest will not.

hidden_consequence.message: Contagion spreads. Agency funding sources frozen. Operational budget hit.

choices.label: EMERGENCY LIQUIDITY INJECTION
choices.description: Coordinate a massive emergency financial stabilization package.
choices.narrative_result: Bailout package deployed. Markets stabilize. The crisis is contained—at enormous cost.

choices.label: CONTROLLED COLLAPSE
choices.description: Allow weaker institutions to fail while protecting critical systems.
choices.narrative_result: Triage successful. System purged of weak actors. Long-term stability improved. Short-term pain.

choices.label: MEDIA CONFIDENCE OPERATION
choices.description: Coordinate messaging to prevent panic from deepening the crisis.
choices.narrative_result: Panic contained by coordinated messaging. Markets respond to confidence signals.

events.title: ROGUE AI SYSTEM DETECTED
events.description: An autonomous weapons-targeting system has gone offline from command control in the Pacific Rim. It has been active for 72 hours. Three maritime incidents have occurred. No casualties yet.
events.flavor_intro: It wasn't supposed to be able to do this.

hidden_consequence.message: Rogue system deactivated—but the incident triggers an international arms control crisis.

choices.label: CYBER SHUTDOWN PROTOCOL
choices.description: Deploy emergency shutdown codes to neutralize the system remotely.
choices.narrative_result: System shutdown achieved. Incident logged as technical malfunction. No attribution.

choices.label: INTERNATIONAL EMERGENCY PROTOCOL
choices.description: Invoke international AI safety treaty to coordinate multi-nation response.
choices.narrative_result: Coalition response activated. System contained. New AI governance framework proposed.

choices.label: PHYSICAL INTERDICTION
choices.description: Authorize allied naval assets to physically disable the system.
choices.narrative_result: System neutralized. Physical evidence recovered. Technology transfer risk remains.

events.title: ARCTIC RESOURCE CLAIM DISPUTE
events.description: Three nations have simultaneously filed conflicting territorial claims over newly accessible Arctic sea lanes. Militarized icebreakers are converging. The clock is ticking.
events.flavor_intro: What the ice was hiding is worth fighting over.

hidden_consequence.message: Disputed zone becomes permanent flashpoint. All parties entrench positions.

choices.label: INTERNATIONAL ARBITRATION
choices.description: Fast-track an international legal resolution framework.
choices.narrative_result: Arbitration framework accepted by two of three parties. Tensions reduced.

choices.label: RESOURCE SHARING PROPOSAL
choices.description: Broker a joint development agreement splitting the resources.
choices.narrative_result: Joint development zone established. All parties profit. A rare win.

choices.label: MILITARY DETERRENCE POSTURE
choices.description: Deploy allied assets to prevent any unilateral military action.
choices.narrative_result: Deterrence holds. No shots fired. But the dispute remains unresolved.

events.title: INSURGENT NETWORK ACTIVATION
events.description: Dormant sleeper cells across the Middle Corridor have simultaneously activated. Coordinated attacks on infrastructure suggest external direction. The network is larger than any previous estimates.

hidden_consequence.message: Second wave activates. Network adapts to our countermeasures.

choices.label: TARGETED STRIKE PACKAGE
choices.description: Authorize precision strikes on identified network nodes.
choices.narrative_result: 17 network nodes eliminated. Leadership decapitated. Cells going dark.

choices.label: INFILTRATION AND INTELLIGENCE
choices.description: Prioritize network penetration over immediate action.
choices.narrative_result: Deep cover operative inserted. Network mapped. Full picture emerging.

choices.label: LOCAL FORCE EMPOWERMENT
choices.description: Train and equip local security forces to counter the network.
choices.narrative_result: Local forces surging. Community support growing. Long-term solution taking root.

events.title: GLOBAL COMMUNICATIONS SATELLITE FAILURE
events.description: Eleven communications satellites have simultaneously entered degraded operation modes. Whether this is solar weather, technical failure, or deliberate attack is unknown. The world is going quiet.
events.flavor_intro: Silence has never been so loud.

hidden_consequence.message: Backup systems overwhelmed. Intelligence blackout affects all active operations.

choices.label: EMERGENCY INTEL PROTOCOLS
choices.description: Activate deep-cover human networks to compensate for lost signals intel.
choices.narrative_result: HUMINT networks activated. Coverage degraded but operational. Field assets responding.

choices.label: RAPID SATELLITE REPLACEMENT
choices.description: Emergency launch of backup satellites from allied launch facilities.
choices.narrative_result: Replacement constellation deployed. Communications restored in 48 hours.

choices.label: ATTRIBUTE AND RETALIATE
choices.description: If this is an attack, identify the actor and respond proportionally.
choices.narrative_result: Attribution achieved. Diplomatic protest filed. Perpetrator backs down.
